entries.en: Dear Goolie, The hot springs around Ashpine Vale have been erupting way too often lately. This old ghost really can't take the heat anymore, so I'm heading up the snow peak to cool off for a while. I'm leaving this Halloween in your hands—hang in there, little ghost!

Dear Goolie

苍松谷最近的热泉喷发越来越频繁啦，我这个老幽灵有点受不住了，得去雪山上休息一段时间。这次的万圣节就交给你吧，加油吧小幽灵

entries.en: "I've never worked a Halloween shift before! All the seniors say it's the biggest night of the year for the Shadow Society. It's the only night humans can actually see us, AND we have to strictly follow the Code of Silence so we don't blow our cover... Talk about tough! Plus, there are way too many humans wandering around town tonight—even kids running down the street in short sleeves and plastic capes... Ugh, whatever! Time to hit the road!"
entries.zhHans: 我从来没有经历过万圣节，前辈都说这是暗影社会的大事件，这是人类唯一能看到我们的机会，还得遵守缄默法则，不被人类发现，这可真难！而且今晚镇上晃荡的人类好像格外多，连穿短袖套塑料披风的小孩都在街上跑……不管了，先出发吧！
entries.zhHant: 我從來沒有經歷過萬聖節，前輩都說這是暗影社會的大事件，這是人類唯一能看到我們的機會，還得遵守緘默法則，不被人類發現，這可真難！而且今晚鎮上晃蕩的人類好像格外多，連穿短袖套塑料披風的小孩都在街上跑……不管了，先出發吧！

entries.en: (Tilts her head toward Goolie, whispering) "...Thank you."
"You're very welcome! Say, why is it dripping so much inside this mountain tunnel? Even the gravel under the railroad ties is pooling with water!"
entries.zhHans: 不客气！不过这穿山隧道里怎么滴答滴答的，连铁轨枕木底下都积水啦？

entries.en: (Gently rubs her damp violin bow with her fingertips, lowering her crimson eyes) "...The rock walls keep seeping water lately. My strings got slippery... A little rosin... will fix it."
entries.zhHans: （用指尖轻轻蹭了蹭有些发潮的琴弓，垂下红眼睛低声说）……最近岩壁总在渗水，弦有点滑。擦了松香……就好了。
entries.zhHant: （用指尖輕輕蹭了蹭有些發潮的琴弓，垂下紅眼睛低聲說）……最近岩壁總在滲水，弦有點滑。擦了松香……就好了。

entries.en: "Oh, I see! Well, thank you for using Ghost Express! Hope to serve you again soon—bye now!"
entries.zhHans: 原来是这样，也谢谢你对幽灵快递的支持，希望以后继续选择我们，再见！
entries.zhHant: 原來是這樣，也謝謝你對幽靈快遞的支持，希望以後繼續選擇我們，再見！

entries.en: (Says nothing, simply holding out a cassette tape with both hands.)

"Got it, got it! This must be the tape Miss Vampire asked for. The boss told me you're debuting a new song at tomorrow's party—I'm so curious! Thank you for everything you do for Ashpine Vale's night community!"
entries.zhHans: 好的好的，这是Vampire姐姐需要的录音带吧。听店长说，明天的party会有你的新歌，我太好奇了，谢谢你为苍松谷暗夜社会作出的贡献！
entries.zhHant: 好的好的，這是Vampire姐姐需要的錄音帶吧。聽店長說，明天的party會有你的新歌，我太好奇了，謝謝你為蒼松谷暗夜社會作出的貢獻！

entries.en: (The tips of her ears twitch slightly as she offers a shy smile.)
"I'll leave you to your practice then. Bye, Miss Artist!"
entries.zhHans: 那我不打扰你练琴啦，艺术家再见！
entries.zhHant: 那我不打擾你練琴啦，藝術家再見！

entries.en: "Right on time! Here's the block of rosin for our great artist, Miss Drow. Give her my best, will ya?"
entries.zhHans: 来得正好！这是我们的伟大艺术家，Miss.Drow的松香块，请代我向她问好
entries.zhHant: 來得正好！這是我們的偉大藝術家，Miss.Drow的松香塊，請代我向她問好

entries.en: "I heard she plays the violin! Rosin is used for maintaining the bow, right?"
entries.zhHans: 我听说这位艺术家会拉小提琴，松香是用于养护小提琴的吧
entries.zhHant: 我聽說這位藝術家會拉小提琴，松香是用於養護小提琴的吧

entries.en: "Aren't you a sharp little ghost! Catch ya later!"
entries.zhHans: 真是位博学的小幽灵，回见！
entries.zhHant: 真是位博學的小幽靈，回見！

entries.en: "Oh, Goolie! That rich, fresh scent of blood—must be Miss Vampire's signature Spicy Blood Stew, huh?"
entries.zhHans: 哦，Goolie，这新鲜的血的气息，想必是Vampire女士的拿手好菜毛血旺吧
entries.zhHant: 哦，Goolie，這新鮮的血的氣息，想必是Vampire女士的拿手好菜毛血旺吧

entries.en: "Yep! Still piping hot. Ghost Express never lets you down!"
entries.zhHans: 是的，还是滚烫的，幽灵快递您放心！
entries.zhHant: 是的，還是滾燙的，幽靈快遞您放心！

entries.en: "Awesome! I spent the whole day chasing off human brats who wandered into the woods just 'cause the weather's warm—my bones are practically falling apart. I really can't stand dealing with humans; no idea how Witch puts up with 'em. Still, getting a bite of this on a chaotic Halloween Eve instantly turns my mood around!"
entries.zhHans: 太棒了，今天我在林子里撵了一整天趁着天暖和乱跑的人类小孩，骨头都快散架了。我是真不爱跟人类打交道，不知道女巫怎么忍受的了。不过万圣夜这种糟心时间能吃上这一口，心情瞬间好起来了！
entries.zhHant: 太棒了，今天我在林子里攆了一整天趁著天暖和亂跑的人類小孩，骨頭都快散架了。我是真不愛跟人類打交道，不知道女巫怎麼忍受的了。不過萬聖夜這種糟心時間能吃上這一口，心情瞬間好起來了！

entries.en: "These jars of Ashpine autumn honey are for Little Bear. Normally this time of year, the bees only gather honeydew seeping from the pines, but lately some wild roses have been blooming out of season. Didn't feel like using 'em for honey, so I boiled 'em into jam for Grandma Jiangshi to bake flower cakes. We've got a party to throw tomorrow, after all!"
entries.zhHans: 这些是给小熊的灰松秋蜜，本来这个季节的蜜蜂只能找到灰松上渗出的甘露酿蜜，可是最近还有一些反季重开的玫瑰花。不过我没打算用来酿蜜，还是熬成酱交给 Jiangshi 老太太做鲜花饼吃吧，毕竟明天我们要开派对了
entries.zhHant: 這些是給小熊的灰松秋蜜，本來這個季節的蜜蜂只能找到灰松上滲出的甘露釀蜜，可是最近還有一些反季重開的玫瑰花。不過我沒打算用來釀蜜，還是熬成醬交給 Jiangshi 老太太做鮮花餅吃吧，畢竟明天我們要開派對了

entries.en: "Totally agree! I heard about Mrs. Jiangshi's rose pastries even before I moved to Ashpine Vale. I'd love to try one!"
entries.zhHans: 我赞同，我还没来灰松谷就听说过IJ太太的鲜花饼呢，真想试一试呀。
entries.zhHant: 我贊同，我還沒來灰松谷就聽說過IJ太太的鮮花餅呢，真想試一試呀。

entries.en: "That old lady's got magic hands in the kitchen. Eat your fill tomorrow!"
entries.zhHans: 那老太太手艺好着呢，明天尽情享受吧！
entries.zhHant: 那老太太手藝好著呢，明天盡情享受吧！

entries.en: "Hello there, little ghost. This is a light spring mead I started brewing back in April and May, aged right up until now. Could you please take it to Miss Witch for me?"
entries.zhHans: 你好呀小幽灵，这些是今年四五月春天就开始酿造、一直陈酿到现在的轻度蜂蜜酒，请你帮我送给女巫女士。
entries.zhHant: 你好呀小幽靈，這些是今年四五月春天就開始釀造、一直陳釀到現在的輕度蜂蜜酒，請你幫我送給女巫女士。

entries.en: "Hi, Little Bear! Wow, this mead looks so golden and bright—even the water droplets on the bottles are glowing!"
entries.zhHans: 小熊你好，这些酒看起来像金灿灿的，连瓶身上的水珠都在发光呢
entries.zhHant: 小熊你好，這些酒看起來像金燦燦的，連瓶身上的水珠都在發光呢

entries.en: "Mhm! Spring honey comes from wildflowers, while autumn honey comes from pine honeydew, which looks more like deep amber. Though... usually the cellar is nice and chilly by late October, just right for storing wine. This year, I had to push all the barrels into the deepest corner just to keep them cool."
entries.zhHans: 对哦，春蜜一般是花蜜，而秋蜜是松树甘露蜜，会更像琥珀一些。说起来，往年这时候地窖里冷飕飕的正好存酒，今年我却得把酒桶挪到最深处的墙角才行呢。
entries.zhHant: 對哦，春蜜一般是花蜜，而秋蜜是松樹甘露蜜，會更像琥珀一些。說起來，往年這時候地窖里冷颼颼的正好存酒，今年我卻得把酒桶挪到最深處的牆角才行呢。

entries.en: "Thanks for your hard work! I'll deliver them safe and sound. Have fun tomorrow!"
entries.zhHans: 辛苦你啦，我一定稳稳当当地送到，祝你明天玩得开心！
entries.zhHant: 辛苦你啦，我一定穩穩當當地送到，祝你明天玩得開心！

entries.en: "Look! Big Sis Wolfwoman sent over this autumn honey—it smells so fresh and piney! She also said it's gotten so warm that flowers are blooming out of season, and asked me to bring some flower jam to Mrs. Jiangshi."
entries.zhHans: 请看，这些是狼人姐姐给的秋蜜，闻起来很清新呢。她还说，现在太热了，已经有反季花盛开了，托我给 Jiangshi 太太送过去。
entries.zhHant: 請看，這些是狼人姐姐給的秋蜜，聞起來很清新呢。她還說，現在太熱了，已經有反季花盛開了，托我給 Jiangshi 太太送過去。

entries.en: (Hugs the honey jar tightly, letting out a tiny yawn before rubbing her eyes) "No wonder I've been hearing water trickling underneath the cellar floor these past few days... Even the soil feels warm."
entries.zhHans: （抱紧蜜罐，打了个小小的哈欠却又揉了揉眼睛）难怪这两天总听到地窖底下有淅淅沥沥的流水声，连土都是温的。
entries.zhHant: （抱緊蜜罐，打了個小小的哈欠卻又揉了揉眼睛）難怪這兩天總聽到地窖底下有淅淅瀝瀝的流水聲，連土都是溫的。

entries.en: "Huh? Is that gonna mess with your hibernation?"
"Yeah... It's definitely going to be a warm winter this year. I think I'm going to have insomnia."
entries.zhHans: 会呀……今年一定会有个暖冬，我可能要失眠了。
entries.zhHant: 會呀……今年一定會有個暖冬，我可能要失眠了。

entries.en: (Pops the cassette into the deck for a quick listen, her fingers tapping the desk to the melody) "Hmm, I can feel the emotion pouring through this track. Miss Drow must have woven the sound of melting glaciers into the melody—it's so ethereal and lovely. She truly has a gift for storytelling through music; even before we met, she was recording the sights and sounds of all the places she wandered... Little ghost, our ears are in for a real treat at the party."
entries.zhHans: （将磁带放进机器试听了一下，手指随着旋律轻敲桌面）我大概能领会到这首曲子的感情，Drow 小姐肯定融入了冰川融水的声音，这实在是空灵而美妙。她真的很擅长用音乐讲故事呢，在我认识她以前，她就用音乐记录过许多地方的风物……小幽灵，这次派对要大饱耳福啦。
entries.zhHant: （將磁帶放進機器試聽了一下，手指隨著旋律輕敲桌面）我大概能領會到這首曲子的感情，Drow 小姐肯定融入了冰川融水的聲音，這實在是空靈而美妙。她真的很擅長用音樂講故事呢，在我認識她以前，她就用音樂記錄過許多地方的風物……小幽靈，這次派對要大飽耳福啦。

entries.en: "Miss Vampire, here's the cooling unit and the fresh livestock blood you asked Miss Witch to pick up."
entries.zhHans: Vampire女士，这是您托Witch女士购买的散热装置还有禽畜的新鲜血液。
entries.zhHant: Vampire女士，這是您托Witch女士購買的散熱裝置還有禽畜的新鮮血液。

entries.en: "Always so conscientious, little ghost! My old radiator suddenly overloaded and quit while I was testing the gear earlier, forcing my late-night broadcast off the air. Now I can finally get the studio back to a comfortable temperature." (She leans in and plants a gentle kiss on the little ghost's cheek.)
entries.zhHans: 真是尽职呢小幽灵！刚才调试设备的时候，老散热器突然过载罢工，害得我的夜间电台都停播了，这下又可以恢复到舒适的温度啦。（说完亲了小幽灵一口。）
entries.zhHant: 真是盡職呢小幽靈！剛才調試設備的時候，老散熱器突然過載罷工，害得我的夜間電台都停播了，這下又可以恢復到舒適的溫度啦。（說完親了小幽靈一口。）

entries.en: (Instantly turns bright pink) "W-Whoa! Miss Vampire... please don't tease me!"
entries.zhHans: （一下子脸红）Vampire女士……不要戏弄我啦
entries.zhHant: （一下子臉紅）Vampire女士……不要戲弄我啦

entries.en: "Here you go, darling—a fresh batch of Spicy Blood Stew I just whipped up. Hurry and take it to Sister Wolfwoman before the studio cools down; she must be starving after patrolling the woods all day."
entries.zhHans: 喏，这是我刚刚做好的毛血旺哟，趁着播音室里还没凉下来，小幽灵快去送给狼人姐姐吃吧，她巡林肯定饿坏了。
entries.zhHant: 喏，這是我剛剛做好的毛血旺喲，趁著播音室里還沒涼下來，小幽靈快去送給狼人姐姐吃吧，她巡林肯定餓壞了。

entries.en: (Takes the jar and gives it a sniff, her eyes crinkling into a warm smile) "Oh my? Out-of-season roses? I've lived here for over a century, and I've never seen anything like it. It keeps getting warmer and warmer... When I got up this evening for my skincare routine and looked up at the peaks, even the snowcap had shrunk..."
entries.zhHans: （接过罐子闻了闻，眯起眼睛笑起来）哦？反季花，我在这里生活上百年了，以前哪有这样的事哦。现在越来越暖和了，我傍晚起来做保养的时候往山上看，连雪山的雪顶都变少了……
entries.zhHant: （接過罐子聞了聞，眯起眼睛笑起來）哦？反季花，我在這裡生活上百年了，以前哪有這樣的事哦。現在越來越暖和了，我傍晚起來做保養的時候往山上看，連雪山的雪頂都變少了……

entries.en: "Oh no, what are we gonna do?"

"Who knows, maybe this whole valley will flood one day... My room full of antiques certainly can't handle a soaking, and I'd hate to leave this place behind. Come, lend an old lady a hand lighting the stove—I'll bake a fresh batch of flower cakes tonight!"
entries.zhHans: 说不定以后这片山谷会被淹没……我这一屋子的老古董可经不起泡水，真是舍不得这里呀。来，帮我搭把手生个炉子，老太太我今晚就把鲜花饼烤出来！
entries.zhHant: 說不定以後這片山谷會被淹沒……我這一屋子的老古董可經不起泡水，真是捨不得這裡呀。來，幫我搭把手生個爐子，老太太我今晚就把鮮花餅烤出來！

entries.en: "You're such a sweetheart, little ghost—you've saved these old bones of mine! The whole reason I settled down in these museum ruins was for the leftover climate-control machines; the temperature and humidity suited me wonderfully. Alas, dampness keeps seeping up between the floor tiles lately, and the old machines just can't keep up. It's even muggier than when I crossed the ocean all those years ago! I have to slather on two extra layers of desiccant like body lotion during my daily routine!"
entries.zhHans: 你真是个贴心的小幽灵，拯救了我这把老骨头。我当年选择住在博物馆遗迹里，就是因为这里还有剩余的环境调节器，温度和湿度都很适合我。可惜最近地砖缝里总往外返潮气，老机器也不中用啦，简直比我以前远渡重洋的时候还潮呢，我每天做日常护理都得把防潮剂当身体乳往身上多刷两层呢！
entries.zhHant: 你真是個貼心的小幽靈，拯救了我這把老骨頭。我當年選擇住在博物館遺跡里，就是因為這裡還有剩餘的環境調節器，溫度和濕度都很適合我。可惜最近地磚縫里總往外返潮氣，老機器也不中用啦，簡直比我以前遠渡重洋的時候還潮呢，我每天做日常護理都得把防潮劑當身體乳往身上多刷兩層呢！

entries.en: "Mrs. Jiangshi, will you keep living here in the future?"
entries.zhHans: IJ太太，您以后会继续住在这里吗
entries.zhHant: IJ太太，您以後會繼續住在這裡嗎

entries.en: "Hard to say, dear. Maybe I'll pack up and move further north? This endless warming certainly doesn't bode well for us."
entries.zhHans: 我可说不好，或许迁去更北的地方？这样的持续变暖可真不是好事呀。
entries.zhHant: 我可說不好，或許遷去更北的地方？這樣的持續變暖可真不是好事呀。

entries.en: "Hello, Miss Witch! Here's the mead sent over by Little Bear."
entries.zhHans: Witch女士您好，这是小熊送来的蜜酒。
entries.zhHant: Witch女士您好，這是小熊送來的蜜酒。

entries.en: "Just looking at this mead, I can almost see spring blossoms blanketing the woods and smell the rich aroma of wildflowers. Good wine truly is a journal of the seasons."
entries.zhHans: 只是看着这些蜜酒，我仿佛能看到春花开遍森林，嗅到馥郁的花草香，这些酒是季节的记事本。
entries.zhHant: 只是看著這些蜜酒，我彷彿能看到春花開遍森林，嗅到馥郁的花草香，這些酒是季節的記事本。

entries.en: "Wow, Miss Witch, you talk just like a poet!"
entries.zhHans: Witch女士您实在是太有文化了
entries.zhHant: Witch女士您實在是太有文化了

entries.en: (Chuckles softly) "Perhaps that's what happens when you live among humans for so long."
entries.zhHans: （咯咯笑）或许因为我一直和人类生活在一起吧
entries.zhHant: （咯咯笑）或許因為我一直和人類生活在一起吧

entries.en: "Tuck this away safely, dear—it's the moisture absorber for Mrs. Jiangshi. I heard groundwater has started seeping into her basement. I do hope she's holding up alright."
entries.zhHans: 收好哦，这是给IJ太太的防潮剂。听说她那里地下水渗入地下室了，希望她一切平安
entries.zhHant: 收好哦，這是給IJ太太的防潮劑。聽說她那裡地下水滲入地下室了，希望她一切平安

entries.en: "And here's the radiator for Miss Vampire. I truly cannot picture such an elegant lady rolling up her sleeves to fix heavy machinery... Plus some fresh livestock blood—tell her to enjoy her meal."
entries.zhHans: 这是给Vampire女士的散热器，我无法想象她这样的优雅鬼士是如何维修那些大型机械的；还有这些禽畜血，祝她吃得开心
entries.zhHant: 這是給Vampire女士的散熱器，我無法想象她這樣的優雅鬼士是如何維修那些大型機械的；還有這些禽畜血，祝她吃得開心

entries.en: "I'm sure Big Sis Vampire will handle it without a hitch!"
entries.zhHans: 我相信Vampire大姐姐肯定可以完美解决的。
entries.zhHant: 我相信Vampire大姐姐肯定可以完美解決的。

entries.en: The human parade has finally come to an end—now, the real holiday for monsters begins. With music playing and mead flowing, though the folks of Ashpine Vale may one day part ways, right here, right now, we are together. As for tomorrow, tomorrow is another night.
entries.zhHans: 人类的巡游终于落幕，接下来，就是属于鬼怪们的节日了。琴声响起，蜜酒斟满，虽然苍松谷的大家以后可能会分道扬镳，但至少在此刻，我们依然团聚在一起。至于明天，明天又是新的一天了。
entries.zhHant: 人類的巡遊終於落幕，接下來，就是屬於鬼怪們的節日了。琴聲響起，蜜酒斟滿，雖然蒼松谷的大家以後可能會分道揚鑣，但至少在此刻，我們依然團聚在一起。至於明天，明天又是新的一天了。

entries.zhHant: 所有訂單都能一起帶走。

entries.en: Halloween Eve. Choose an order at its sender and plan your route.
entries.zhHans: 万圣夜送件开始。到寄件人处接单，再规划路线。
entries.zhHant: 萬聖夜送件開始。到寄件人處接單，再規劃路線。

entries.en: Orders available here. Open Orders [Tab] to choose a batch.
entries.zhHans: 这里有待取包裹，按 Tab 选一单。
entries.zhHant: 這裡有待取包裹，按 Tab 選一單。

entries.zhHans: 按 Tab 选一单，再去寄件人那里取件。
entries.zhHant: 按 Tab 選一單，再去寄件人那裡取件。

entries.en: Speak to the locals. The Halloween party is almost ready.
entries.zhHans: 派对快开始了，可与居民交谈。
entries.zhHant: 派對快開始了，可與居民交談。

entries.zhHant: 。可用 5 車輛回合；換車消耗 1 訂單回合。

entries.zhHans: 已改为幽灵运送，可继续送件。
entries.zhHant: 已改為幽靈運送，可繼續送件。

entries.zhHant: 單已送達，本次送件完成。

entries.zhHant: 車輛已耗盡，改為幽靈運送。

entries.zhHant: 這份存檔無法讀取，加載後會重新開始。

entries.zhHant: 滿載會降低速度並增加車輛消耗

entries.en: Deliver the Cooling Unit from Settlement Bar to the vampire DJ.
entries.zhHans: 先把酒馆的散热装置送给吸血鬼。
entries.zhHant: 先把酒館的散熱裝置送給吸血鬼。

entries.en: Keep dry - protect it during river crossings
entries.zhHans: 怕水，涉水时需用 W 防水车保护
entries.zhHant: 怕水，涉水時需用 W 防水車保護

entries.zhHans: 易碎，经过颠簸路段时需用 Q 避震车保护
entries.zhHant: 易碎，經過顛簸路段時需用 Q 避震車保護

entries.zhHans: 换车：+1 订单回合，新车可用 5 回合。
entries.zhHant: 換車：+1 訂單回合，新車可用 5 回合。

entries.zhHans: 部分订单会超过目标回合。

entries.zhHant: 要刪除第 {0} 個存檔嗎？

entries.zhHans: 途中停靠 · 按 E 继续
entries.zhHant: 途中停靠 · 按 E 繼續

entries.zhHans: 路况事件 · 赶路暂停
entries.zhHant: 路況事件 · 趕路暫停

entries.en: A letter is waiting for you there. Click the glowing tunnel to see your route.
entries.zhHans: 那里有封给你的信。点击发光的隧道查看路线。
entries.zhHant: 那裡有封給你的信。點擊發光的隧道查看路線。

entries.en: Parcels are ready here. Click the box arrow in Orders to collect them. Pickup starts the delivery clock.
entries.zhHans: 这里有包裹要寄。点击订单里的箱子箭头取件，配送回合从取件算起。
entries.zhHant: 這裡有包裹要寄。點擊訂單裡的箱子箭頭取件，配送回合從取件算起。

entries.en: Click the glowing box to see the orders. The box arrow collects parcels at your stop.
entries.zhHans: 点击发光的箱子查看订单。箱子箭头可收取本站的包裹。
entries.zhHant: 點擊發光的箱子查看訂單。箱子箭頭可收取本站的包裹。

entries.en: Your recipient is marked on the map. Click their stop to see the orange route. The green arrow sets you off.
entries.zhHans: 收件地点已标在地图上。点地点查看橙色路线，绿色箭头出发。
entries.zhHant: 收件地點已標在地圖上。點地點查看橙色路線，綠色箭頭出發。

entries.en: Just a stop along the way. E or the arrow continues the route. Parcels are delivered on arrival.
entries.zhHans: 这儿只是中途站。E 或箭头继续赶路，到收件地点就会自动送达。
entries.zhHant: 這兒只是中途站。E 或箭頭繼續趕路，到收件地點就會自動送達。

entries.en: F skips ahead to the next stop or event. E keeps you moving at waypoints.
entries.zhHans: F 快进到下个站点或事件，中途停靠时按 E 继续。
entries.zhHant: F 快轉到下個站點或事件，中途停靠時按 E 繼續。

entries.en: Click the glowing green arrow to depart. The clock shows the estimated turns.
entries.zhHans: 点击发光的绿色箭头出发。时钟旁是预计要走的回合数。
entries.zhHant: 點擊發光的綠色箭頭出發。時鐘旁是預計要走的回合數。

entries.en: Something happened on the road. The event card has the details; the green check confirms.
entries.zhHans: 路上出了点状况。详情写在事件卡上，绿色勾确认。
entries.zhHant: 路上出了點狀況。詳情寫在事件卡上，綠色勾確認。

entries.en: First delivery done. More parcels are waiting in Orders.
entries.zhHans: 第一单送到了。订单里还有包裹等着你。
entries.zhHant: 第一單送到了。訂單裡還有包裹等著你。

entries.en: On the way to a sender
No parcels on board yet, so the delivery clock is off. F skips travel; E continues at waypoints.
entries.zhHans: 还没取件，不用赶时间。F 快进路程，中途停靠时按 E 继续。
entries.zhHant: 還沒取件，不用趕時間。F 快轉路程，中途停靠時按 E 繼續。

entries.en: The sender is further along this route. E or the arrow keeps you going.
entries.zhHans: 寄件人还在前面。E 或箭头继续赶路。
entries.zhHant: 寄件人還在前面。E 或箭頭繼續趕路。

entries.zhHans: 消耗一回合给他们分糖
entries.zhHant: 消耗一回合給他們分糖

entries.en: Spend 1 turn rummaging for dog-safe snacks.
entries.zhHans: 消耗一回合寻找狗狗能吃的食物
entries.zhHant: 消耗一回合尋找狗狗能吃的食物

entries.en: Spend 1 turn holding your breath and pretending to be a plastic prop until they leave.
entries.zhHans: 消耗一回合屏住呼吸假装自己是塑料挂件，等他们拍完照离开
entries.zhHant: 消耗一回合屏住呼吸假裝自己是塑料掛件，等他們拍完照離開

entries.en: Spend 1 turn fanning the little bat to cool it down.
entries.zhHans: 消耗一回合给小蝙蝠扇风降温
entries.zhHant: 消耗一回合給小蝙蝠扇風降溫

entries.en: Move back 1 node to dodge the hot steam.
entries.zhHans: 倒退一个节点躲避热泉蒸汽
entries.zhHant: 倒退一個節點躲避熱泉蒸汽

entries.en: Move back 1 node to duck away from the human crowd.
entries.zhHans: 倒退一个节点紧急避让人类巡游队
entries.zhHant: 倒退一個節點緊急避讓人類巡遊隊

entries.en: Dear Goolie, The hot springs around Ashpine Vale have been erupting way too often lately.
entries.zhHans:
Dear Goolie

苍松谷最近的热泉喷发越来越频繁啦。
entries.zhHant:
Dear Goolie

蒼松谷最近的熱泉噴發越來越頻繁啦。

entries.en: This old ghost really can't take the heat anymore, so I'm heading up the snow peak to cool off for a while.
entries.zhHans: 我这个老幽灵有点受不住了，得去雪山上休息一段时间。
entries.zhHant: 我這個老幽靈有點受不住了，得去雪山上休息一段時間。

entries.en: I'm leaving this Halloween in your hands—hang in there, little ghost!
entries.zhHans: 这次的万圣节就交给你吧，加油吧小幽灵
entries.zhHant: 這次的萬聖節就交給你吧，加油吧小幽靈

entries.en: "I've never worked a Halloween shift before!"
entries.zhHans: 我从来没有经历过万圣节。
entries.zhHant: 我從來沒有經歷過萬聖節。

entries.en: "All the seniors say it's the biggest night of the year for the Shadow Society."
entries.zhHans: 前辈都说这是暗影社会的大事件。
entries.zhHant: 前輩都說這是暗影社會的大事件。

entries.en: "Ugh, whatever! Time to hit the road!"
(Gently rubs her damp violin bow with her fingertips, lowering her crimson eyes)
entries.zhHans: （用指尖轻轻蹭了蹭有些发潮的琴弓，垂下红眼睛低声说）
entries.zhHant: （用指尖輕輕蹭了蹭有些發潮的琴弓，垂下紅眼睛低聲說）

entries.en: "...The rock walls keep seeping water lately. My strings got slippery... A little rosin... will fix it."
entries.zhHans: ……最近岩壁总在渗水，弦有点滑。擦了松香……就好了。
entries.zhHant: ……最近岩壁總在滲水，弦有點滑。擦了松香……就好了。

entries.en: "Got it, got it! This must be the tape Miss Vampire asked for."
entries.zhHans: 好的好的，这是Vampire姐姐需要的录音带吧。
entries.zhHant: 好的好的，這是Vampire姐姐需要的錄音帶吧。

entries.en: "The boss told me you're debuting a new song at tomorrow's party—I'm so curious!"
entries.zhHans: 听店长说，明天的party会有你的新歌，我太好奇了。
entries.zhHant: 聽店長說，明天的party會有你的新歌，我太好奇了。

entries.en: "Thank you for everything you do for Ashpine Vale's night community!"
entries.zhHans: 谢谢你为苍松谷暗夜社会作出的贡献！
entries.zhHant: 謝謝你為蒼松谷暗夜社會作出的貢獻！

entries.en: "I really can't stand dealing with humans; no idea how Witch puts up with 'em."
entries.zhHans: 我是真不爱跟人类打交道，不知道女巫怎么忍受的了。
entries.zhHant: 我是真不愛跟人類打交道，不知道女巫怎麼忍受的了。

entries.en: "Still, getting a bite of this on a chaotic Halloween Eve instantly turns my mood around!"
entries.zhHans: 不过万圣夜这种糟心时间能吃上这一口，心情瞬间好起来了！
entries.zhHant: 不過萬聖夜這種糟心時間能吃上這一口，心情瞬間好起來了！

entries.en: "These jars of Ashpine autumn honey are for Little Bear."
entries.zhHans: 这些是给小熊的灰松秋蜜。
entries.zhHant: 這些是給小熊的灰松秋蜜。

entries.en: "but lately some wild roses have been blooming out of season."
entries.zhHans: 可是最近还有一些反季重开的玫瑰花。
entries.zhHant: 可是最近還有一些反季重開的玫瑰花。

entries.en: "Didn't feel like using 'em for honey, so I boiled 'em into jam for Grandma Jiangshi to bake flower cakes."
entries.zhHans: 不过我没打算用来酿蜜，还是熬成酱交给 Jiangshi 老太太做鲜花饼吃吧。
entries.zhHant: 不過我沒打算用來釀蜜，還是熬成醬交給 Jiangshi 老太太做鮮花餅吃吧。

entries.en: "We've got a party to throw tomorrow, after all!"
entries.zhHans: 毕竟明天我们要开派对了
entries.zhHant: 畢竟明天我們要開派對了

entries.en: "Hello there, little ghost. This is a light spring mead I started brewing back in April and May, aged right up until now."
entries.zhHans: 你好呀小幽灵，这些是今年四五月春天就开始酿造、一直陈酿到现在的轻度蜂蜜酒。
entries.zhHant: 你好呀小幽靈，這些是今年四五月春天就開始釀造、一直陳釀到現在的輕度蜂蜜酒。

entries.en: "Could you please take it to Miss Witch for me?"
entries.zhHans: 请你帮我送给女巫女士。
entries.zhHant: 請你幫我送給女巫女士。

entries.en: "Mhm! Spring honey comes from wildflowers, while autumn honey comes from pine honeydew, which looks more like deep amber."
entries.zhHans: 对哦，春蜜一般是花蜜，而秋蜜是松树甘露蜜，会更像琥珀一些。
entries.zhHant: 對哦，春蜜一般是花蜜，而秋蜜是松樹甘露蜜，會更像琥珀一些。

entries.en: "Though... usually the cellar is nice and chilly by late October, just right for storing wine."
entries.zhHans: 说起来，往年这时候地窖里冷飕飕的正好存酒。
entries.zhHant: 說起來，往年這時候地窖里冷颼颼的正好存酒。

entries.en: "This year, I had to push all the barrels into the deepest corner just to keep them cool."
entries.zhHans: 今年我却得把酒桶挪到最深处的墙角才行呢。
entries.zhHant: 今年我卻得把酒桶挪到最深處的牆角才行呢。

entries.en: "Look! Big Sis Wolfwoman sent over this autumn honey—it smells so fresh and piney!"
entries.zhHans: 请看，这些是狼人姐姐给的秋蜜，闻起来很清新呢。
entries.zhHant: 請看，這些是狼人姐姐給的秋蜜，聞起來很清新呢。

entries.en: "and asked me to bring some flower jam to Mrs. Jiangshi."
entries.zhHans: 托我给 Jiangshi 太太送过去。
entries.zhHant: 托我給 Jiangshi 太太送過去。

entries.en: (Hugs the honey jar tightly, letting out a tiny yawn before rubbing her eyes)
entries.zhHans: （抱紧蜜罐，打了个小小的哈欠却又揉了揉眼睛）
entries.zhHant: （抱緊蜜罐，打了個小小的哈欠卻又揉了揉眼睛）

entries.en: "No wonder I've been hearing water trickling underneath the cellar floor these past few days... Even the soil feels warm."
entries.zhHans: 难怪这两天总听到地窖底下有淅淅沥沥的流水声，连土都是温的。
entries.zhHant: 難怪這兩天總聽到地窖底下有淅淅瀝瀝的流水聲，連土都是溫的。

entries.en: (Pops the cassette into the deck for a quick listen, her fingers tapping the desk to the melody)
entries.zhHans: （将磁带放进机器试听了一下，手指随着旋律轻敲桌面）
entries.zhHant: （將磁帶放進機器試聽了一下，手指隨著旋律輕敲桌面）

entries.en: "Hmm, I can feel the emotion pouring through this track."
entries.zhHans: 我大概能领会到这首曲子的感情。
entries.zhHant: 我大概能領會到這首曲子的感情。

entries.en: "Miss Drow must have woven the sound of melting glaciers into the melody—it's so ethereal and lovely."
entries.zhHans: Drow 小姐肯定融入了冰川融水的声音，这实在是空灵而美妙。
entries.zhHant: Drow 小姐肯定融入了冰川融水的聲音，這實在是空靈而美妙。

entries.en: "Little ghost, our ears are in for a real treat at the party."
entries.zhHans: 小幽灵，这次派对要大饱耳福啦。
entries.zhHant: 小幽靈，這次派對要大飽耳福啦。

entries.en: "My old radiator suddenly overloaded and quit while I was testing the gear earlier, forcing my late-night broadcast off the air."
entries.zhHans: 刚才调试设备的时候，老散热器突然过载罢工，害得我的夜间电台都停播了。
entries.zhHant: 剛才調試設備的時候，老散熱器突然過載罷工，害得我的夜間電台都停播了。

entries.en: "Now I can finally get the studio back to a comfortable temperature."
entries.zhHans: 这下又可以恢复到舒适的温度啦。
entries.zhHant: 這下又可以恢復到舒適的溫度啦。

entries.en: (She leans in and plants a gentle kiss on the little ghost's cheek.)
"Here you go, darling—a fresh batch of Spicy Blood Stew I just whipped up."
entries.zhHans: 喏，这是我刚刚做好的毛血旺哟。
entries.zhHant: 喏，這是我剛剛做好的毛血旺喲。

entries.en: "Hurry and take it to Sister Wolfwoman before the studio cools down; she must be starving after patrolling the woods all day."
entries.zhHans: 趁着播音室里还没凉下来，小幽灵快去送给狼人姐姐吃吧，她巡林肯定饿坏了。
entries.zhHant: 趁著播音室里還沒涼下來，小幽靈快去送給狼人姐姐吃吧，她巡林肯定餓壞了。

entries.en: (Takes the jar and gives it a sniff, her eyes crinkling into a warm smile)
entries.zhHans: （接过罐子闻了闻，眯起眼睛笑起来）
entries.zhHant: （接過罐子聞了聞，眯起眼睛笑起來）

entries.en: "Oh my? Out-of-season roses? I've lived here for over a century, and I've never seen anything like it."
entries.zhHans: 哦？反季花，我在这里生活上百年了，以前哪有这样的事哦。
entries.zhHant: 哦？反季花，我在這裡生活上百年了，以前哪有這樣的事哦。

entries.en: "When I got up this evening for my skincare routine and looked up at the peaks, even the snowcap had shrunk..."
entries.zhHans: 我傍晚起来做保养的时候往山上看，连雪山的雪顶都变少了……
entries.zhHant: 我傍晚起來做保養的時候往山上看，連雪山的雪頂都變少了……

entries.en: "Who knows, maybe this whole valley will flood one day..."
entries.zhHans: 说不定以后这片山谷会被淹没……
entries.zhHant: 說不定以後這片山谷會被淹沒……

entries.en: "My room full of antiques certainly can't handle a soaking, and I'd hate to leave this place behind."
entries.zhHans: 我这一屋子的老古董可经不起泡水，真是舍不得这里呀。
entries.zhHant: 我這一屋子的老古董可經不起泡水，真是捨不得這裡呀。

entries.en: "Come, lend an old lady a hand lighting the stove—I'll bake a fresh batch of flower cakes tonight!"
entries.zhHans: 来，帮我搭把手生个炉子，老太太我今晚就把鲜花饼烤出来！
entries.zhHant: 來，幫我搭把手生個爐子，老太太我今晚就把鮮花餅烤出來！

entries.en: "You're such a sweetheart, little ghost—you've saved these old bones of mine!"
entries.zhHans: 你真是个贴心的小幽灵，拯救了我这把老骨头。
entries.zhHant: 你真是個貼心的小幽靈，拯救了我這把老骨頭。

entries.en: "the temperature and humidity suited me wonderfully."
entries.zhHans: 温度和湿度都很适合我。
entries.zhHant: 溫度和濕度都很適合我。

entries.en: "Alas, dampness keeps seeping up between the floor tiles lately, and the old machines just can't keep up."
entries.zhHans: 可惜最近地砖缝里总往外返潮气，老机器也不中用啦。
entries.zhHant: 可惜最近地磚縫里總往外返潮氣，老機器也不中用啦。

entries.en: "It's even muggier than when I crossed the ocean all those years ago!"
entries.zhHans: 简直比我以前远渡重洋的时候还潮呢。
entries.zhHant: 簡直比我以前遠渡重洋的時候還潮呢。

entries.en: "I have to slather on two extra layers of desiccant like body lotion during my daily routine!"
entries.zhHans: 我每天做日常护理都得把防潮剂当身体乳往身上多刷两层呢！
entries.zhHant: 我每天做日常護理都得把防潮劑當身體乳往身上多刷兩層呢！

entries.en: "Just looking at this mead, I can almost see spring blossoms blanketing the woods and smell the rich aroma of wildflowers."
entries.zhHans: 只是看着这些蜜酒，我仿佛能看到春花开遍森林，嗅到馥郁的花草香。
entries.zhHant: 只是看著這些蜜酒，我彷彿能看到春花開遍森林，嗅到馥郁的花草香。

entries.en: "Good wine truly is a journal of the seasons."
entries.zhHans: 这些酒是季节的记事本。
entries.zhHant: 這些酒是季節的記事本。

entries.en: "Tuck this away safely, dear—it's the moisture absorber for Mrs. Jiangshi."
entries.zhHans: 收好哦，这是给IJ太太的防潮剂。
entries.zhHant: 收好哦，這是給IJ太太的防潮劑。

entries.en: "I heard groundwater has started seeping into her basement. I do hope she's holding up alright."
entries.zhHans: 听说她那里地下水渗入地下室了，希望她一切平安
entries.zhHant: 聽說她那裡地下水滲入地下室了，希望她一切平安

entries.en: "And here's the radiator for Miss Vampire."
"I truly cannot picture such an elegant lady rolling up her sleeves to fix heavy machinery..."
entries.zhHans: 我无法想象她这样的优雅鬼士是如何维修那些大型机械的。
entries.zhHant: 我無法想象她這樣的優雅鬼士是如何維修那些大型機械的。

entries.en: "Plus some fresh livestock blood—tell her to enjoy her meal."
entries.zhHans: 还有这些禽畜血，祝她吃得开心
entries.zhHant: 還有這些禽畜血，祝她吃得開心

entries.en: The human parade has finally come to an end—now, the real holiday for monsters begins.
entries.zhHans: 人类的巡游终于落幕，接下来，就是属于鬼怪们的节日了。
entries.zhHant: 人類的巡遊終於落幕，接下來，就是屬於鬼怪們的節日了。

entries.en: "It's the only night humans can actually see us."
entries.zhHans: 这是人类唯一能看到我们的机会。
entries.zhHant: 這是人類唯一能看到我們的機會。

entries.en: "And we have to strictly follow the Code of Silence so we don't blow our cover... Talk about tough!"
entries.zhHans: 还得遵守缄默法则，不被人类发现，这可真难！
entries.zhHant: 還得遵守緘默法則，不被人類發現，這可真難！

entries.en: "Plus, there are way too many humans wandering around town tonight."
entries.zhHans: 而且今晚镇上晃荡的人类好像格外多。
entries.zhHant: 而且今晚鎮上晃蕩的人類好像格外多。

entries.en: "Even kids running down the street in short sleeves and plastic capes..."
entries.zhHans: 连穿短袖套塑料披风的小孩都在街上跑……
entries.zhHant: 連穿短袖套塑料披風的小孩都在街上跑……

entries.en: "Awesome! I spent the whole day chasing off human brats who wandered into the woods just 'cause the weather's warm."
entries.zhHans: 太棒了，今天我在林子里撵了一整天趁着天暖和乱跑的人类小孩。
entries.zhHant: 太棒了，今天我在林子里攆了一整天趁著天暖和亂跑的人類小孩。

entries.en: "Normally this time of year, the bees only gather honeydew seeping from the pines."
entries.zhHans: 本来这个季节的蜜蜂只能找到灰松上渗出的甘露酿蜜。
entries.zhHant: 本來這個季節的蜜蜂只能找到灰松上滲出的甘露釀蜜。

entries.en: "She also said it's gotten so warm that flowers are blooming out of season."
entries.zhHans: 她还说，现在太热了，已经有反季花盛开了。
entries.zhHant: 她還說，現在太熱了，已經有反季花盛開了。

entries.en: "She truly has a gift for storytelling through music."
entries.zhHans: 她真的很擅长用音乐讲故事呢。
entries.zhHant: 她真的很擅長用音樂講故事呢。

entries.en: "Even before we met, she was recording the sights and sounds of all the places she wandered..."
entries.zhHans: 在我认识她以前，她就用音乐记录过许多地方的风物……
entries.zhHant: 在我認識她以前，她就用音樂記錄過許多地方的風物……

entries.en: "The whole reason I settled down in these museum ruins was for the leftover climate-control machines."
entries.zhHans: 我当年选择住在博物馆遗迹里，就是因为这里还有剩余的环境调节器。
entries.zhHant: 我當年選擇住在博物館遺跡里，就是因為這裡還有剩餘的環境調節器。

entries.en: With music playing and mead flowing, though the folks of Ashpine Vale may one day part ways, right here, right now, we are together.
entries.zhHans: 琴声响起，蜜酒斟满，虽然苍松谷的大家以后可能会分道扬镳，但至少在此刻，我们依然团聚在一起。
entries.zhHant: 琴聲響起，蜜酒斟滿，雖然蒼松谷的大家以後可能會分道揚鑣，但至少在此刻，我們依然團聚在一起。

entries.en: As for tomorrow, tomorrow is another night.
entries.zhHans: 至于明天，明天又是新的一天了。
entries.zhHant: 至於明天，明天又是新的一天了。
